messages:
Ellen B: From the postmortem - new recurring pattern: failover telemetry delay causes late routing flips. Need owners for telemetry gating + restore validation.
Marcus J: I'll take telemetry gating. Plan: introduce a 30s smoothing window and require KV-cache warming metric before full weight shift.
Tanya R: I'll own restore validation (timing + integrity). Will run full restores against a staging cluster and attach RTO numbers. ETA Fri.
Ellen B: Can we add an automated preflight check to block rollout if telemetry is stale?
Marcus J: Yes - propose a gate that checks last-metrics-age < 60s and kv_hit_rate > 0.8. Snippet for runbook: ```bash
# gate check
python preflight_gate.py --region us-east --max-metric-age 60 --min-kv-hit 0.8
```
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2026-02-14 09:00 UTC "DR: telemetry gating dry-run"
Tanya R: Also, snapshot restores have been producing different manifest hashes under heavy control-plane load. I'll add checksum verification and a manifest-uniqueness test.
Marcus J: We'll pair on canary: 5% -> 20% after 10m -> rollback if errors>1% or manifest mismatch.
Ellen B: Create ticket INFR-1202 and subtask owners. I'll consolidate and ping ENG-ONCALL once subtasks are up. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-1202
infra-bot: DR rehearsal event created: 2026-02-16 15:00 UTC
Tanya R: :white_check_mark: I'll upload restore logs by Thu EOD.
Marcus J: :white_check_mark: gating PR by Wed.
Ellen B: Thanks. Closing thread; will reopen if anyone misses deadlines.
